newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria executes convicted armed robber.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria executes convicted armed robber.

text.p: A convicted armed robber was publicly shot by firing squad on Saturday in Akure, southwestern Nigeria, the official News Agency of Nigeria (NAN) reported.
It said Francis Igbiwhu, 27, died after the third round of gunshots from five marksmen. A man in the crowd fainted as bullets hit Igbiwhu, NAN said.
Nigeria caused worldwide outrage in 1995 when nine minority rights activists were hanged for murder.
In the same year 43 convicted armed robbers were shot at the maximum security prison in Lagos, watched by a large crowd.
Armed robbery has been punishable by public execution since the end of the civil war in 1970 when violent crime boomed.
Before the sentence was carried out, Igbiwhu told reporters he was innocent and only provided shelter for his friends who committed the crime, NAN reported.
He was condemned to death in November for robbing a woman of cash and other items totalling 450,000 naira ($5,625).
One of his accomplices was sentenced to 75 years in prison while the other died during the course of the trial, NAN said. ($=80 naira)
